files_changed_self_report.rationale: Added the fixture-targeting input and scoped changed-file collection so selftest invocations can evaluate pass/fail fixtures independently without changing default caller behaviour.
Added preflight pin/ratchet validation, tightened permissions, updated the reusable-workflow pin, and passed per-fixture inputs into the two reusable-workflow invocations.
Documented fixture isolation, pin-maintenance procedure, oracle ratchet behaviour, and the staged 020C transition path.
Updated the transition note to reflect the isolated fixture-path flow and the staged deny expectation update.
Pre-positioned the fail fixture with a future-rule violation so 020C can flip only the expected summary while respecting the oracle ratchet.
Added a verify command for duplicated workflow pins and recorded the schema-trigger rationale in the dispatch artifact.
Added the same pin-consistency verify command and scope note to the active fix-round dispatch package.

self_reported_concerns: `docs/plans/WP-SCP-020-policy-federation-primitive.md` was outside the allowed write scope, so the schema-trigger rationale was documented in the in-scope dispatch artifacts rather than in the parent plan row itself.
codex_structured_result.summary: Implemented the R1 selftest fix set in-scope: `policy-check.yml` now accepts a `fixture-path` input and scopes changed-file discovery to each fixture subtree with a fixture-tree fallback for policy-only PRs; `workflow-selftest.yml` now enforces SHA freshness before running, applies minimum per-job permissions, ratchets oracle edits so an existing fixture cannot change both `services.yml` and `expected-annotations.json` in one PR, and invokes isolated pass/fail runs using the current pinned reusable-workflow SHA; the fail fixture/docs were updated so the future deny transition can happen by changing only its expected summary; and the dispatch-package artifacts now include a pin-consistency verify command plus schema-trigger rationale. All required verification commands and targeted sanity checks passed.
